title: CI: public-API snapshot and semver check
description: Add a CI job that snapshots each publishable crate's public API (cargo public-api, committed snapshot files) and/or runs cargo-semver-checks against the last published version, so every public-surface change appears in review diffs. Decide snapshot vs semver-checks (or both) based on toolchain/MSRV fit and run time; document how to bless an intended change. Check tool licenses with cargo deny norms before adding.
